data.gender_notes: Nashit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nashati' meaning 'victorious'. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of a heroic deity who protects the virtuous from evil. The name Nashit carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nashit usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nashit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nashit total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
